description: A new type of search system with pattern recognition. Enterprise-grade search in a class library.
releaseNotes:
The release candidate for 6.0: keys as text, a filter cache limited in megabytes, faster filters,
      and a sort that shows on a text search. Some changes break a build; they are marked below.
      
      ### Added
      
      - **Keys as text.** A record's key is its key field's value as text, so `"sku-17"`, `"0042"` and
        `42` all work, and `42` and `"42"` are the same key. Whole-number keys work as before.
        `ScoreEntry16.Key` is the key as text, beside `DocumentKey`. `GetJsonDataOfKey(string)`,
        `GetJsonDataOfKeys(string[])`, `DeleteJsonRecord(string)`, `DeleteJsonRecords(IEnumerable<string>, …)`
        and `UpdateField(string, …)` take it, and `GetKeyText(long)` and `GetKeyNumber(string)` turn one
        into the other. A record with an empty key is left out and counted.
      - **A filter cache limited in megabytes.** `new SearchEngine(…, filterCacheMB: 256)` sets how much
        the filters kept between searches may take, 256 MB by default, 0 for none; the least recently
        used are let go past it, in the background. `Status.FilterCacheFilters`,
        `FilterCacheBytes` and `FilterCacheLimitBytes` say what the cache holds.
      - **The match report names every field.** With `EnableMatchReport`, each query word has `Fields`:
        every field that met it and how, the counted one first.
      
      ### Changed
      
      - **`SortBy` shows on a text search.** Records are put in tiers of relevance first and sorted by
        the field within each tier, so a sort by price keeps the best matches first and orders each band
        of them by price. Until now it only ordered records with the same score, which on a text search
        were few. An empty search sorts by the field alone, as before.
      - **Common words are not required.** A word the index holds in a great many places ("for", "the"
        in a large catalogue) no longer has to be in a record, is not matched by its misspellings and
        does not count toward the score. Searches with such words find more of what was meant, and the
        slowest of them are faster.
      - **Filling a short page takes one misspelt word in three.** With `Candidates.FillReach`, a record
        fills the page only when at most one word in three of the query is misspelt in it: one of one to
        three words, two of four to six. The near misses stay, the look-alikes go. `FillReach` is 0 by
        default, as before.
      - **`Hibernate` and `Unload` run no garbage collection.** They used to pause the whole process to
        collect, and gave little back. Call `GC.Collect(2, GCCollectionMode.Aggressive, true, true)`
        when it suits you, to return the memory.
      
      ### Faster
      
      - **Range filters** are built in one go: a new price range costs about what a cached one does,
        where it took several times as long before.
      - **Filters on array fields** (tags, categories) are read from an index instead of every record:
        on 650,000 records from over 100 ms to a fraction of a millisecond.
      - **Combined filters** made by chaining `|` or `&` keep only the result, not every step, so writes
        stay fast however many filters are combined. For many values on one field, `CreateInFilter` is
        still the fastest.
      - **Searches with several words** narrow their candidates word by word, rarest first, and stop as
        soon as nothing is left.
      
      ### Breaking
      
      - **`PreloadFilters` is removed:** `Field.PreloadFilters`, `FieldProxy.PreloadFilters` and
        `ISearchEngine.PreLoadedFilters`. A filter is made from the field's index in well under a
        millisecond when first used, and preloading made every insert slower. A saved configuration that
        carries it still loads.
      - **`ConfigurationParameters` has no filter cache size.** `filterCacheSize`, `FilterCacheSize` and
        `DefaultFilterCacheSize` are gone; give `filterCacheMB` to `SearchEngine`. A configuration file
        that carries the old number still loads.
      - **`IPersistence` and `IDatabaseManager` take a key as a string**, for a store of your own.
      - **`Indx.Utilities.RoaringBitmap` is no longer public.**
      
      ### Fixed
      
      - **A search could in rare cases run without its filter**, when a filter was used through
        another instance of the same filter than the one cached. It now always finds the filter's
        records, and a search whose filter cannot be read is refused.
